title: FUJIFILM India dedicates first Made in India EP-6000 Endoscopy System to AIIMS
summary: First “Made in India” EP-6000 Endoscopy System, bearing serial number 001, installed at AIIMS New Delhi following the start of endoscopy manufacturing in Jodhpur

contentHtml:
First “Made in India” EP-6000 Endoscopy System, bearing serial number 001, installed at AIIMS New Delhi following the start of endoscopy manufacturing in Jodhpur

FUJIFILM India has dedicated the first “Made in India” EP-6000 Endoscopy System, bearing serial number 001, to the nation through the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi.

Koji Wada, Managing Director, FUJIFILM India, called upon Shri Jagat Prakash Nadda Ji, Hon’ble Union Cabinet Minister, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, Government of India, to commemorate the launch.

The dedication follows the inauguration of endoscopy manufacturing in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, earlier this year. It marks the next milestone in FUJIFILM India’s endoscopy journey in India and its commitment to the Government of India’s Make in India initiative.

The Fujifilm EP-6000 Endoscopy System is the first “Made in India” Fujifilm Endoscopy System manufactured at the company’s contract manufacturing facility. The dedication of the first system, bearing serial number 001, to the nation through AIIMS represents a milestone in FUJIFILM India’s contribution to India’s medical technology manufacturing journey and reflects the shared commitment of the Government, AIIMS and FUJIFILM India towards strengthening India’s healthcare infrastructure through innovation, technology and local manufacturing.

Prof Nikhil Tandon, Director, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, said, “AIIMS has a longstanding commitment to advancing patient care through the adoption of cutting-edge medical technologies and clinical innovation. The installation of the first ‘Made in India’ EP-6000 Endoscopy System is a meaningful addition to our capabilities and reflects the importance of bringing advanced diagnostic and therapeutic technologies to institutions serving patients at scale. We are pleased to be part of this milestone in India’s evolving medical technology ecosystem.”

Prof. Pramod Garg, Professor and Head, Department of Gastroenterology and Human Nutrition Unit, AIIMS, New Delhi, said, “We are happy that that manufacturing for endoscopes has been established in India. AIIMS has a long-standing commitment to advancing patient care through the adoption of cutting-edge medical technologies and clinical innovation. The installation of the first Made in India Endoscope system will add to our capabilities to serve patients at large.”

Koji Wada, Managing Director, FUJIFILM India, said, “This milestone is an important part of Fujifilm’s roadmap to deepen our healthcare footprint in India. It reflects our group purpose of ‘Giving our world more smiles’ by supporting India’s healthcare providers with capabilities that will strengthen diagnostic infrastructure. We continue to remain committed to bringing our diverse ideas and unique capabilities together to change the world.”

With the dedication of the first “Made in India” EP-6000 Endoscopy System, FUJIFILM India continues to contribute to India’s medical technology manufacturing journey and strengthen its commitment to the country’s healthcare and Make in India ambitions.
